text: Two jobs in one run: K4 at key length 26 against shuffles of itself, and the same search carried to two unknown alphabets, its power measured on planted English at lengths 8, 13 and 16.
After 28 minutes the two-alphabet part ran out of time while drawing shuffles that fit. One text had no finished search, and that broke the summary, so no result was kept.
0142 ran the length-26 job alone. 0143 ran the two-alphabet power test.
